chunks: Harun ibn al-Jahm informed me, from Abu Hamza, from Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him), who said:
If the inhabitants of the heaven and earth were to gather together to describe Allah by His magnificence, they would not be able to.

key_terms.أَهْلُ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ: Inhabitants of the heaven and earth — a comprehensive expression denoting all creation
key_terms.بِعَظَمَتِهِ: By His magnificence/greatness — describing Allah in accordance with His true majesty
key_terms.لَمْ يَقْدِرُوا: They would not be able to — absolute impossibility of adequate description
key_terms.يَصِفُوا: To describe/characterize — the act of attributing qualities to Allah

ai.seo_question: Can the inhabitants of the heavens and earth describe Allah's magnificence?
ai.summary: Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn Zayn al-Abidin (peace be upon him), the fourth Imam, teaches the absolute transcendence of Allah beyond all human capacity for description. Even if every being in the heavens and the earth united their efforts, they could not adequately describe Allah's true magnificence. This hadith is situated in a chapter prohibiting the description of Allah with attributes other than those He has Himself revealed, underscoring the limits of human language and intellect in comprehending the Divine.
word_analysis: be able to/have the power to

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad and Muhammad Bin Al Hassan, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Bashir Al Barqy who said, ‘Abbas Bin Aamir Al Qasbany narrated to me saying, ‘Haroun Bin Al Jahm informed me, from Abu Hamza, (It has been narrated) from Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘If the inhabitants of the sky and the earth were to gather together in describing Allah<sup>azwj</sup> by His<sup>azwj</sup> Magnificence, they would not be able to’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Muhammad and Muhammad ibn al-Hassan have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Bashir al-Barqi who has said that ‘Abbass ibn ‘Amir al-Qasbani who has said that Harun ibn al-Juham from abu Hamza from Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn (a.s.) has reported the following.
“Even if all those in heavens and earth would gather together to speak of the greatness of Allah they will not be able to do so.”
